significance: A Shiva temple in Bera village, Mathura district, whose walled complex also holds shrines to Ram and Sita, Ganesha, Brahma, Durga, Radha Krishna, Shani and Hanuman beside a sacred tank. A fair is held each March and Mahashivratri draws the largest crowds.
story: The Shiva idol of the main shrine is said to have been found in the Alkheswar Kund, the pond adjoining the temple.
